messages:
alex_support: Customer (acct CC-789) reports bill ~3x their SDK token counts last week. SDK shows ~900k tokens, invoice 2.7M. Billing ref INV-98721. Who can take?

kira_sre: @alex_support can you paste SDK version, region, and a minimal repro? streaming or non-streaming?

alex_support: They're on node sdk v0.10.1, using streaming. Estimate call made client-side via `sdk.tokenEstimate(messages)` before stream open. Repro payload:

``
model: "redwood-large-v1"
messages: [{role: "system", content: "You are ..."}, {role: "user", content: "Please summarize..."}]
stream: true
max_tokens: 512
```

ben_billing: I pulled metering for that account — lots of short extra records tied to same request ids labeled as `trace_event` / `tool`. They add up.

sam_devx: We shipped a small gateway change that appends a JSON trace as a final tool event for observability. Could that be included in metering?

kira_sre: Checking staging — gateway indeed emits an extra stream event after normal `done` called `role:tool` with name `gw-diagnostics` and a 100–150 token JSON body. Our runtime tokenizes anything forwarded into the model path, so metering counts it.

metering-bot: [ingest] record: req=zz01 type=gw-diagnostics tokens=132 host=gw-1 zone=us-east-1

alex_support: SDK estimator never sees that trailing tool event because it stops counting after client-visibility `done`. If customer stops stream early they won't see those tokens either.

ben_billing: That explains multiplier. Client estimate = prompt + visible completion. Invoice = prompt + completion + injected gw diagnostics + possible retries of short tool calls.

sam_devx: Repro with curl shows final SSE chunk:

``
data: {"role":"assistant","content":"..."}

event: done

data: {"role":"tool","name":"gw-diagnostics","content":"{\"latency\":54,\"tokens\":128}"}
```

kira_sre: Confirmed on canary. Gateway forwards trace into model runtime to keep ordering semantics; runtime tokenizes it. Bad default.

ben_billing: Short term options: 1) issue a one-time invoice credit while we audit, 2) make SDK estimator warn about potential invisible tokens for streaming, 3) change gateway to emit diagnostics out-of-band.

finance: tagged. We need exact account and token delta summary to approve credits.

alex_support: I'll collect account-level raw metering export and send to FIN. Also messaging customer with explanation + offered temporary credit if they want.

kira_sre: I'll prepare a patch to stop forwarding gw diagnostics into the model path (emit to telemetry pipeline instead) and add a config flag. Target PR this week.

sam_devx: Also add a gateway config to mark events `internal:true` so metering can ignore them if desired.

ben_billing: Opening FIN ticket FIN-4522 and flagging audit. meter-bot: [audit] start FIN-4522 scope=acct-CC-789

metering-bot: [ingest] summary: account=CC-789 visible=900k inferred-internal=1.8M total=2.7M

alex_support: Reply to customer drafted. Will wait for FIN ack before applying any credit. Leaving thread open until gateway patch and audit complete. :white_check_mark:

kira_sre: Note: also check for other sidecars (langchain connectors, reward tools) that might insert system/tool messages that client estimators don't anticipate.

ben_billing: Agree. Scanning other accounts for similar patterns now.
